A '''hydroponics droid''' or '''hydromech droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] designed to locate and extract [[Water/Legends|water]] from underground sources such as [[aquifer]]s. Appendages included a retractable vertical sounding array and filtered moisture extractor. Sediment was dispersed from a top-mounted exhaust pipe. It also performed maintenance duties on [[GX-8 water vaporator/Legends|GX-8 water vaporators]].

One particular model used on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was the [[Mini-Huvicko/Yuzabi Dowser binary hydromech droid|M-HYD binary hydromech droid]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] first identified this type of droid as a "hydroponics" droid, however, the term "hydromech" was later coined for the [[Databank (original)|Databank]].
